title: Getting Started with IDConverter
text: IDConverter converts identifiers within biological databases. Core use cases: TCGA/ICGC/PCAWG sample ID conversion Human ↔︎ Mouse gene ortholog mapping Gene symbol ↔︎ Ensembl ID conversion Gene alias resolution GDC manifest parsing tumor-normal pairing

title: Getting Started with IDConverter
code: library(IDConverter)  # TCGA sample ID → patient ID convert_tcga("TCGA-02-0001-10") #> [1] "TCGA-02-0001"  # ICGC specimen → donor convert_icgc("SP29019") #> [1] "DO13695"  # PCAWG specimen → donor convert_pcawg("SP1677") #> [1] "DO804"  # Custom database dt <- data.table::data.table(   UpperCase = LETTERS[1:5],   LowerCase = letters[1:5] ) convert_custom(c("B", "C", "E"), from = "UpperCase", to = "LowerCase", dt = dt) #> [1] "b" "c" "e"

title: Getting Started with IDConverter
code: # Symbol → Ensembl (human) convert_hm_genes(c("TP53", "KRAS"), type = "symbol")  # Ensembl → Symbol (human) convert_hm_genes("ENSG00000141510")  # Human → Mouse orthologs convert_hm_orthologs(c("TP53", "KRAS"))

title: Getting Started with IDConverter
code: # List available tables ls_annotables()  # Load from Zenodo (fixed version, works offline) grch38 <- load_data("grch38")  # Or build from Ensembl BioMart (latest, requires biomaRt + internet) grch38_latest <- build_annotables("grch38", tx2gene = FALSE)

title: Convert Identifiers in Biological Databases
text: ID conversions: convert_custom() - Convert custom database identifiers. convert_icgc() - Convert ICGC identifiers. convert_pcawg() - Convert PCAWG identifiers. convert_tcga() - Convert TCGA identifiers. convert_hm_genes() - Convert human/mouse/worm gene IDs Ensembl Hugo Symbol system. convert_hm_orthologs() - Convert gene IDs human mouse via Ensembl orthology (e.g., TP53 ↔︎ Trp53). Annotation tables: ls_annotables() - List available annotation tables annotables. load_data() - Download load annotation data Zenodo (fixed version) local cache. build_annotables() - Build --date gene annotation tables directly Ensembl BioMart (supports 11 organisms, requires biomaRt). resolve_gene_aliases() - Resolve outdated/alternative gene symbols (aliases) official symbols via Ensembl synonym data. Utilities: pair_gdc_samples() - Pair tumor-normal samples GDC manifest files. parse_gdc_file_uuid() - Parse Metadata GDC Portal File UUID. filter_tcga_barcodes() - Filter TCGA Replicate Sample Barcodes.

what: Build Gene Annotation Tables from Ensembl BioMart — build_annotables
title: Build Gene Annotation Tables from Ensembl BioMart — build_annotables
text: Queries Ensembl BioMart directly build --date gene annotation tables ("annotables") using recipes derived annotables package. provides latest annotations Ensembl internet available, alternative fixed-version tables stored Zenodo.

title: Build Gene Annotation Tables from Ensembl BioMart — build_annotables
code: build_annotables(   recipes = NULL,   tx2gene = TRUE,   include_synonyms = FALSE,   mirrors = ENSEMBL_MIRRORS,   cache_dir = getOption("IDConverter.datapath", tempdir()),   verbose = TRUE )

title: Build Gene Annotation Tables from Ensembl BioMart — build_annotables
text: recipes character vector recipe names build, NULL build available recipes. Use ls_annotables() see organisms available (matching "gene" + "tx2gene" table names). Recipe names include "grch38", "grch37", "grcm38", "bdgp6", "galgal5", "rnor6", "mmul801", "wbcel235", "cfamiliaris", "drerio", "sscrofa". tx2gene TRUE (default), also build transcript--gene mapping tables (appended _tx2gene suffix). include_synonyms TRUE, also fetch external_synonym (gene name aliases) BioMart include synonym column output tables. Default FALSE faster queries. mirrors character vector Ensembl mirror URLs try order. function automatically falls back next mirror failure. cache_dir directory path cache downloaded tables .rda files. Set NULL skip caching. Default uses package's data path (customizable via options(IDConverter.datapath = ...)). verbose TRUE, print progress messages.

title: Build Gene Annotation Tables from Ensembl BioMart — build_annotables
text: named list data.frame objects (tibbles). list names correspond recipe names (_tx2gene variants tx2gene = TRUE). Returns invisible(NULL) total failure.

title: Build Gene Annotation Tables from Ensembl BioMart — build_annotables
text: Requirements: function requires Bioconductor package biomaRt. Install : Mirror fallback: Ensembl mirrors can unreliable. function tries mirror mirrors recipe one succeeds. mirrors fail recipe, recipe skipped warning. Caching: cache_dir set, successfully downloaded tables saved .rda files. Subsequent calls cache_dir load cache instead re-querying, unless cache_dir = NULL.
code: if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))     install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install("biomaRt")

what: Convert Gene IDs Between Human and Mouse via Orthology — convert_hm_orthologs
title: Convert Gene IDs Between Human and Mouse via Orthology — convert_hm_orthologs
text: Maps gene symbols Ensembl IDs human mouse using Ensembl BioMart orthology data. resolves homologous gene relationships (e.g., human TP53 <-> mouse Trp53).

title: Convert Gene IDs Between Human and Mouse via Orthology — convert_hm_orthologs
code: convert_hm_orthologs(   IDs,   from_species = c("human", "mouse"),   to_species = c("mouse", "human"),   from_type = c("symbol", "ensembl"),   to_type = c("symbol", "ensembl", "both"),   multiple = FALSE,   high_confidence_only = TRUE,   mirrors = ENSEMBL_MIRRORS,   cache_dir = getOption("IDConverter.datapath", tempdir()),   verbose = TRUE )

title: Convert Gene IDs Between Human and Mouse via Orthology — convert_hm_orthologs
text: IDs character vector gene symbols Ensembl IDs. from_species source species: "human" (default) "mouse". to_species target species: "mouse" (default) "human". Must differ from_species. from_type type input IDs: "symbol" (default) "ensembl". to_type type output IDs: "symbol" (default), "ensembl", "" return columns. multiple TRUE, return data.frame ortholog matches (e.g., one--many relationships). high_confidence_only TRUE (default), restrict orthologs high confidence (confidence == 1) Ensembl. mirrors character vector Ensembl mirror URLs. cache_dir directory cache query results. Set NULL skip. verbose TRUE, print progress messages.

title: Convert Gene IDs Between Human and Mouse via Orthology — convert_hm_orthologs
text: multiple = FALSE, character vector converted IDs (NA unmatched). multiple = TRUE to_type = "", data.frame.
